_comment: Machines page. route local = run on the deck's own mac; ssh = pipe box/fleet-logins.sh over `ssh <ssh> [wsl] sh -s` (no install on the box); push = the machine runs `sh fleet-logins.sh push http://<tailnet-ip>:3131/api/machines <id>` on a cron. `ssh` is a deploy-cert alias from ~/.ssh/deploy-certs/current, never a 1Password-agent or static-key alias. `host` is the deck's own host key (hosts.json, plus `mac` for the deck itself) where the machine has one, so a machines row joins to that host's sessions and leases.
